messages:
sam_partnerships: Heads up  Nebula Systems confirmed a co-hosted "Marketplace Launch + Hands-on Lab" on June 14. Need to align speakers, lab access, marketplace listing date, and swag (power banks).
jordan_hw: We want to show low-power inferencing on Nebula edge nodes. Will we run the live lab from their rack or from Redwood Private behind their VPC?
tamara_pm: Partner requested Nebula run the on-site lab (they have racks), but we must provide a sandboxed trial on Redwood Private as backup and to capture leads.
liang_eng: For backup we can spin up a dedicated lab cluster. I can pre-load the quantized model and create ephemeral API keys. Need SSO info for partner users.
mel_ops: Shipping: Nebula will handle in-studio demo kit. Redwood will ship 250 power banks to Nebula HQ for giveaways and 50 to our SF office for followups. Need customs paperwork if any items go to EU.
sophia_marketing: Swag creative: mockups look good. Do we have sponsor logo lockups from Nebula? Also want a co-branded landing page and UTM params.
dmitri_nebula: Confirmed on logos. Will send print-ready SVGs by Tue. Also Nebula can provide a short "why Nebula + Redwood" soundbite for the opener.
sam_partnerships: Great  speaker roster suggestion: Tamara (Redwood product), Dmitri (Nebula lead), Jordan (hardware demo), Priya (customer cameo). Priya ok? @dmitri_nebula please confirm customer cameo.
dmitri_nebula: Priya confirmed. She can do 3-4 min live Q.
liang_eng: Tech notes  lab access plan: create ephemeral keys with scope=lab:read and TTL=8h. Example: LAB_KEY=lab_abc123. We'll post provisioning steps:
```
export LAB_KEY=lab_abc123
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $LAB_KEY" https://lab.redwood-inference.com/run -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
Also will provide a preflight health endpoint: /_status returns OK.
jordan_hw: For live demo failover we want: studio -> Nebula rack -> Redwood Private fallback. Can we route by healthcheck and still show a seamless reconnection?
liang_eng: Yes. We have canary routing rules. We'll add header X-Partner: nebula and instruct studio to switch if /_status != OK.
mel_ops: Timeline for shipments: power banks US ship by May 20, EU ship by May 28. Who owns fulfillment? Sam/RD team?
sam_partnerships: Redwood will own fulfillment. Please send final address spreadsheet by May 10.
sophia_marketing: Landing page: I'll build co-branded LP and collect emails + trial request. Need copy: 1-2 sentences, CTA, and promo code. Who owns the promo code?
dmitri_nebula: Nebula can provide a partner promo code: NEBULA20. Works for trials (20% extended trial credits).
tamara_pm: Deck deadlines: speakers to submit a 6-slide deck by June 1. Rehearsal date? Prefer one full run on June 10.
calendar-bot: Rehearsal created  June 10 08:00 PDT, duration 120m. Invitees: sam_partnerships, jordan_hw, tamara_pm, liang_eng, dmitri_nebula, priya_customer.
liang_eng: Security note: we'll use short-lived keys and IP allowlist for studio. Need Nebula's studio egress IPs. @dmitri_nebula can you share?
dmitri_nebula: Sending IP list DM now.
mel_ops: Customs contact for EU: "Marcel" at Nebula logistics. Sam, can you coordinate paperwork?
sam_partnerships: On it. Also confirm we want a post-webinar lab voucher email and swag raffle. Sophia can we schedule followup drip?
sophia_marketing: Yes, 3-email drip: thanks+link, lab voucher, partner case study. I'll draft and post in #marketing for review.
jordan_hw: Equipment checklist for rehearsal: USB capture, spare 10Gb NIC, power brick, and Nebula demo key. I'll bring the spare NIC.
liang_eng: I'll provision the demo key and upload to secure share.
tamara_pm: One more: marketplace listing timing. We want the AWS Marketplace listing to go live the day after webinar (Jun 15). Is Nebula coordinating product listing with marketplace partner team?
dmitri_nebula: Nebula's marketplace lead is looping in AWS. We're aiming for Jun 15 but will confirm by May 12.
sam_partnerships: Final action items: 1) Speaker decks by Jun 1, 2) Lab keys + healthcheck by May 25, 3) Swag addresses by May 10, 4) Logo/SVGs by Apr 30, 5) Marketplace confirmation by May 12. Anything else?
mel_ops: Please cc logistics@redwood on all shipping docs.
sam_partnerships: Will do. Thanks team :rocket:
